title: The Borrowed Furnace: VhalSera's Cinderlain
summary: Balance the furnace with shared valves while destroying conduits that pull its pressure toward safety.
overview: The two sixth-floor wings feed one furnace. Clear its preparation in the lower wing, then fight the Cinderlain in the upper room with both controls available beside the battle.

The pressure gauge begins at 50. Keep it between 30 and 70 by choosing the correct valve, and prepare for the announced heat feed every 40 seconds. One operator can lead the calls, but any eligible player can use the controls.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Read the pressure value and the announced direction change.
Do not use a valve simply because its cooldown has ended; decide whether pressure needs to rise or fall.

roles.label: Valve operator
tips: Cold lowers pressure by 20; Heat raises it by 20.
Each interaction takes two seconds, and both valves share a ten-second lock.
Compensate for the direction change every 30 seconds.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Kill brittle conduits to move pressure ten points toward 50.
At most two conduits remain alive; use them when the operator is occupied.

roles.label: Tank and healers
tips: At either extreme, expect 10% extra boss melee until pressure returns to the safe band.
Extreme cold or heat also pulses every six seconds.

phases.label: Expose the controls
phases.description: Clear the conduit guards before advancing to the upper furnace. This is preparation for one boss, not a second equipment encounter.

phases.label: Keep the borrowed years in balance
phases.description: Pressure starts at 50 and trends five points every six seconds toward the announced heat or cold direction. The direction changes every 30 seconds.

phases.label: The furnace falls silent
phases.description: The furnace releases its stolen years and the summit mirror opens.

abilities.name: Furnace Pressure
description: At 20 or lower, cold pulses for 200 damage every six seconds; at 80 or higher, fire pulses for 200. At either extreme the boss gains 10% melee damage until the gauge returns to the safe band.
The gauge remains recoverable even at its limits. Correct the direction rather than abandoning an otherwise viable attempt.

abilities.name: Cold and Heat Valves
abilities.summary: Use the two-second interaction on the valve that moves pressure toward 50.
description: The Cold valve lowers pressure by 20 and the Heat valve raises it by 20. Their ten-second lock is shared.
The controls are in the boss arena. Required valve use does not send the party into another wing during combat.

abilities.name: Brittle Conduits
abilities.summary: Destroy a conduit for a correction toward the center.
description: Every 40 seconds, the furnace announces a heat feed with six seconds to respond, then adds 20 pressure. The cycle also creates a brittle conduit when fewer than two are alive. Defeating a conduit shifts pressure ten points toward 50.

sections.title: Expedition access and route
paragraphs: The Seven Silences admits groups of three to six characters of level 55 or higher; six level-60 characters are recommended. Speak to Keeper Avel Rimeglass in Iceclad. Entry requires no raid trophy.
The eight-hour expedition and replay begin at acceptance. The lower floors start below the difficulty of the Mistmoore group expedition, then increase toward comparable pressure on the upper floors.

Ordinary tower keys, keyring entries and the summit shortcut do not unlock this version. Each floor victory unlocks the next expedition mirror and a cleared return checkpoint. The two wings of floor six form one encounter.

sections.title: Warnings and recovery
paragraphs: Read Event Messages and use the named encounter actors. Color and visual effects supplement the instructions; no required answer depends on recognizing a color alone. Keep the fight and its support inside the current encounter area.

Evacuation returns eligible party members to the entrance of this same expedition. Gate and spells that transport you out of the tower remain available; reenter through the keeper while your expedition and membership remain valid. Binding, shadow steps, summons and transport within the tower cannot bypass its mirrors.

A wipe restores the active boss and its attempt-only objectives. Previously completed encounters and route objectives remain completed. Cleared bosses cannot be repeated for another reward during the same expedition.
The expedition supplies the temporary tools needed for each mechanic. No random equipment reward or particular class is required to perform an interaction.

loot.title: Equipment reward
loot.description: Exactly one item is chosen from these four, with a 25% chance for each item. Supporting creatures and encounter objectives do not award additional equipment.

loot.title: Independent raid-entry reward
loot.description: There is a separate 45% chance for one entry splinter per boss victory. This roll does not replace the equipment reward and is not repeated for each player. The splinter is permanent, stackable, No Trade and not Lore.

notes: Reviewed against the authored TOFS quest implementation and generated data. The listed files are uncommitted additions or edits beyond the recorded base revision; their SHA-256 hashes identify the reviewed bytes.
Publication means the guide is ready for the Library. It does not establish game-server deployment, loaded database templates, client spell installation or in-game acceptance.
Role guidance is derived from source and isolated validation. Encounter balance, navigation, camera space and client presentation require matching-version playtests.
Linked spells are the native encounter damage or buff definitions actually used by the adapter. Pure state changes and interactions have no unrelated spell links.
